record.message:
/aw — agent-workflow in Pi. Workers run on the selected executor (default pi; --executor codex or claude).

Workflows:
  /aw list [--query <text>] [--offset N] [--limit N]   list discoverable workflows
  /aw validate <workflow>                              validate a workflow spec
  /aw roles <workflow>                                 show compiled role context
  /aw agents                                           list agent definitions
  /aw show <workflow>                                  print a workflow spec
  /aw profile list|show|set|delete|default …           manage saved user profiles

Runs:
  /aw run <workflow> <task> [options]   start a workflow; returns once it is launched
  /aw dynamic <task> [options]          start a spec-less dynamic workflow
  /aw status [run]                      show runs
  /aw show <run> [--raw]                show run details
  /aw inspect <run> [--failures] [--results]
  /aw wait <run> [--timeout <duration>] one bounded wait (at most 45 s); repeat while running
  /aw resume <run> [--detach]           resume a failed, interrupted or blocked run
  /aw stop <run>                        stop a run
  /aw prune [--keep N] [--older-than DAYS] [--yes]
  /aw notices list | acknowledge <run> --state <sha256> --reason <text> | clear <run>

Run options: --executor <id> --profile <name> --permission-mode free|safe --allow-unverified <a,b> --model <id> --effort <level> --detach --force-new
With a Pi UI, capability degradations that need confirmation are asked; without one they are recorded and the run proceeds.
Agent tools: aw_list, aw_run, aw_dynamic, aw_wait. /aw help <action> shows the agent-workflow help of one action.

deep-research: Planner-driven deep research workflow: plan research questions by depth, fan out question research, normalize/rank claims, verify selected claims, preserve a full audit final, and render a compact executive handoff.
  spec: <repo>/workflows/deep-research/spec.json; agent=researcher, readOnly=true
deep-review: Planner-gated deep review workflow: cheap triage selects review lenses, reviewers produce findings, deterministic dedup collapses duplicates, devil's advocate challenges findings, deterministic partition applies verdicts, bounded packet isolation feeds narrative synthesis, and the final renderer writes the full-ledger evidence-backed report.
  spec: <repo>/workflows/deep-review/spec.json; agent=scout, readOnly=true
impact-review: Read-only DAG impact review: map a proposed or applied change, analyze contract, state/data, validation, docs/release, and security/performance impact in parallel, then join those lenses into ship-risk and action-plan synthesis without editing files.
  spec: <repo>/workflows/impact-review/spec.json; agent=scout, readOnly=true
spec-review: Read-only spec conformance review: extract requirements from a referenced spec, map implementation and tests in parallel, verify candidate gaps, and produce an evidence-backed report without editing files.
  spec: <repo>/workflows/spec-review/spec.json; agent=scout, readOnly=true
